correctness.rationale: The proof independently derives flux F=chi times half-space mass, inverts the gas and liquid flux-density relations and integrates the exact flux ODE to compute every radial quantile. The difference is an explicitly positive flux integral and constant for the outer quantile interval, giving exact W_infinity by monotone rearrangement; Tonelli gives W_1. For optimizer uniqueness f_m has explicitly negative second derivative because m(1-u/m)^2>1-2u/m; an endpoint sign G(q) strictly decreases from 1/4 to negative infinity and has one zero, proving the threshold. Pointwise high-m limits and monotone root trapping prove the high-m optimum. The standalone verifier passed 1,070 tests, including independent numerical integration of the published stationary profile. Finite checks are auxiliary and not universal proofs.

originality.rationale: Grange (arXiv:2610.26149v2) supplies explicit individual gas and droplet stationary profiles, interface matching, mass conservation, and a nonmonotone droplet half-width. Direct examination of its relevant sections did not find a quantified first-order stochastic ordering between the simultaneous stationary branches, their exact sharp W_infinity or W_1 transport comparison, an all-tail-level horizontal displacement theorem, or the new density-slowdown threshold m*=7.322227... governing the maximum transport contrast. These cross-phase, cross-parameter statements are proved by additional flux/quantile comparison and strict-concavity analysis. One-dimensional quantile transport itself is classical and not claimed anew. published-finding corpus searches and 48 accessible own ledger claims yielded no implication-equivalent result. Remaining priority risk exists because explicit profiles in the source are strong inputs and uncatalogued derivations may exist.
residual_risks: The primary paper determines exact single-branch profiles, so a reader may derive additional transport properties from them; the claim is only for a new proved cross-branch comparison and critical contrast threshold.
No exhaustive survey of all unpublished calculations, supplementary notes, or non-indexed results was possible; absence from published-finding corpus/web is not proof of priority.
The secondary literature sources listed as abstracts were not asserted to have been searched in full.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 model has two physically distinct, simultaneously admissible stationary profiles at identical mass and reset settings. A sharp W_infinity comparison and complete radial stochastic order quantify how much more concentrated the droplet is, with exact outer-tail quantile translation and W_1 cost. The sharp density-slowdown threshold m* specifies when resetting produces maximal phase contrast at the coexistence boundary versus a unique interior rate. It is a natural invariant for phase distinguishability and transport, not an arbitrary slice, and the result differs from the known nonmonotonic droplet radius.
